description.value: A Subway franchise sandwich shop on the Old Hope-Princeton Way corridor in Hope, BC — a natural resupply point for cyclists traveling the Crowsnest Highway or moving between the Fraser Valley and the Interior. The location offers made-to-order Footlongs, wraps, salads, and breakfast items with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options. As an independently owned franchise, it serves the small community of Hope where food options along this route are limited.

address.value: 677 Old Hope-Princeton Way, Hope, BC V0X 1L4

OSM tag takeaway=yes and website text ('delivery, in-restaurant dining, or curbside pickup') confirm takeout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null. concerns: Street name spelling discrepancy: OSM records 'Old Hope-Princeton Way' while the Subway website shows 'Old Hope Princetown Way'. The actual road in Hope is named after Princeton, BC, so 'Princeton' is likely correct and the website contains a typo. Address contact_confirmed set to false.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, confirmed-open Subway franchise in Hope, BC — a legitimate food and resupply stop for touring cyclists on a corridor with limited options.
